description.en: The list of devices to be validated in batch.

description.zh:
校验导入的JT/T 808协议云网关设备时，需传入的设备ID。

设备ID支持英文字母、数字、短划线（-），长度限制为4~30个字符。

> 单次调用该接口，最多能传入10,000个设备ID。超过该限制的数据会被丢弃。
description.en:
The device ID that must be specified when validating imported JT/T 808 protocol cloud gateway devices.  

The device ID can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-), and must be 4 to 30 characters in length.  

> A single API call supports up to 10,000 device IDs. Data exceeding this limit will be discarded.

description.zh:
校验导入的JT/T 808协议云网关设备时，需传入的设备型号。

设备型号支持英文字母、数字、短划线（-），长度限制为4~30个字符。

> 单次调用该接口，最多能传入10,000个设备型号。超过该限制的数据会被丢弃。
description.en:
The device model that must be specified when validating imported JT/T 808 protocol cloud gateway devices.  

The device model can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-), and must be 4 to 30 characters in length.  

> A single API call supports up to 10,000 device models. Data exceeding this limit will be discarded.

description.zh:
校验导入的GB/T 32960协议云网关设备时，需传入的设备名称。

设备名称支持英文字母和数字，长度限制为4~17个字符。

> 单次调用该接口，最多能传入10,000个设备名称。超过该限制的数据会被丢弃。
description.en:
The device name that must be provided when validating imported GB/T 32960 protocol cloud gateway devices.  

The device name supports English letters and digits, with a length of 4 to 17 characters.  

> A single API invocation can include up to 10,000 device names. Data exceeding this limit will be discarded.

description.zh:
校验导入的JT/T 808协议云网关设备时，需传入的设备厂商ID。

设备厂商ID支持英文字母、数字、短划线（-），长度限制为4~11个字符。

> 单次调用该接口，最多能传入10,000个设备厂商ID。超过该限制的数据会被丢弃。
description.en:
The Device Manufacturer ID that must be provided when validating imported JT/T 808 protocol cloud gateway devices.  

The Device Manufacturer ID supports English letters, digits, and hyphens (-), with a length of 4 to 11 characters.  

> A single API invocation can include up to 10,000 Device Manufacturer IDs. Data exceeding this limit will be discarded.

description.en: The **ProductKey** of the cloud gateway product to which the device belongs.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
本接口适用于批量校验导入的JT/T 808协议和GB/T 32960协议的云网关设备。


## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为100。

> 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To  
This API is used to batch validate cloud gateway devices that use the JT/T 808 protocol or the GB/T 32960 protocol.  

## QPS Limit  

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 100.  

> All Resource Access Management (RAM) users under an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of that Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot batch-check-vehicle-device --iot-instance-id iot-1n8t0000 --product-key a1Bw0000 --device-list DeviceModel=dm0001 DeviceId=di0001 DeviceSecret=example-string Manufacturer=mf0001 DeviceName=vin0001 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot BatchCheckVehicleDevice --region cn-hangzhou --DeviceList.1.DeviceName vin0001 --IotInstanceId 'iot-1n8t0000' --DeviceList.1.Manufacturer mf0001 --DeviceList.1.DeviceModel dm0001 --DeviceList.1.DeviceSecret 'example-string' --ProductKey a1Bw0000 --DeviceList.1.DeviceId di0001
